## Checks

- [ ] All checks pass locally (`ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pyright`, `vulture`, `pytest`; see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests cover the change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under the unreleased version, if a user notices the change.
- [ ] Docs updated, if behaviour, a device or a setting changed.
- [ ] No Client ID, Client Secret, token, appliance ID, serial number or personal name anywhere in the change.
